acronym: OCCAM (Orthogonal Cognitive Compression via Aligned Mental-models)

structural_framing.description: High structural mutual information tasks where compact topology framing prunes exponential search branches.

symbolic_rollout.description: Irreducible multi-step symbolic/algebraic rollouts requiring relaxed rate-distortion length regularization.

theoretical_foundations: Marr, D. (1982). Vision: A Computational Investigation into the Human Representation and Processing of Visual Information.
Kargupta et al. (2025). Cognitive Foundations for Reasoning and Their Manifestation in LLMs (arXiv:2511.16660).
Nelson, T. O., & Narens, L. (1990). Metamemory: A Theoretical Framework and New Findings.
Rissanen, J. (1978). Modeling by Shortest Data Description (Minimum Description Length, MDL).
Pearl, J. (2009). Causality: Models, Reasoning, and Inference.
Kahneman, D., & Stanovich, K. E. (2011). Rationality and the Reflective Mind.

primitives.name_zh_en: 目标逆向反演 (Backward Goal Inversion)
primitives.academic_citation: Newell & Simon (1972) Human Problem Solving; Kargupta et al. (2025) arXiv:2511.16660 [Backward Chaining]
primitives.formal_operator_definition: T_inv(S_goal) = {s in S | exists a in A: P(S_goal | s, a) = 1}, pruning forward branching factor b^d to directed predecessor constraints.
primitives.trigger_signature: Forward search space exhibits exponential branching, terminal state or failure mode is uniquely constrained, or problem asks for necessary preconditions / invariant winning strategies.
mandatory_slots: [Terminal_Anchor]: Explicitly formalize target state S_goal or catastrophic failure state S_fail.
[Predecessor_Necessary_Conditions]: Derive strict necessary conditions backwards step-by-step from S_goal to initial state S_0.
[Forward_Branch_Pruning]: Eliminate forward action candidates violating the inverted necessary conditions.
primitives.anti_bias_check: Prohibit blind forward trial-and-error enumeration and sequential forward guessing.

primitives.name_zh_en: 结构同构迁移 (Structural Isomorphism Mapping)
primitives.academic_citation: Gentner, D. (1983) Structure-Mapping: A Theoretical Framework for Analogy; Kargupta et al. (2025) arXiv:2511.16660 [Analogical Mapping & Restructuring]
primitives.formal_operator_definition: f: G_src(V_s, E_s) -> G_tgt(V_t, E_t) such that (u,v) in E_s <=> (f(u), f(v)) in E_t, stripping surface semantics while preserving relational invariants.
primitives.trigger_signature: Unfamiliar domain wording, cross-disciplinary scientific mechanism, or complex narrative masking a canonical mathematical/logical structure (e.g., parity, pigeonhole, conservation law).
mandatory_slots: [Surface_Semantics_Stripping]: Strip domain-specific nouns and narrative distractors into abstract entities V.
[Relational_Isomorphism]: Map relational predicates E_tgt onto a solved canonical structure G_src.
[Invariant_Transfer]: Transfer the theorem/solution invariant from G_src back to instantiate the target answer.
primitives.anti_bias_check: Prohibit superficial feature matching (Surface Analogy Trap) where lexical similarity masks structural divergence.

primitives.name_zh_en: 控制论闭环纠偏 (Cybernetic Error Correction & Backtracking)
primitives.academic_citation: Wiener, N. (1948) Cybernetics; Nelson & Narens (1990) Metacognitive Monitoring & Control; arXiv:2508.04460 [MERA]
primitives.formal_operator_definition: e_t = ||C(s_t) - C_ref||; if e_t > tau, trigger Backtrack(s_t -> s_{t-k}) and update policy constraint Pi_{t+1}.
primitives.trigger_signature: Multi-constraint deduction, spatial/state navigation, or intermediate algebraic state where local steps risk violating global boundary constraints.
mandatory_slots: [State_Checkpoint]: Define verifiable intermediate invariant or coordinate state s_t.
[Constraint_Residual_Audit]: Test intermediate state against all hard boundary constraints C_ref.
[Closed_Loop_Correction]: Confirm zero residual or immediately prune invalid state branch without repetitive 'Wait, let me recalculate' loops.
primitives.anti_bias_check: Prohibit sunk-cost continuation along a contradicted reasoning path and verbose unguided self-doubt loops.

primitives.name_zh_en: 认知边界监控 (Epistemic Boundary Monitoring)
primitives.academic_citation: Fleming, S. M. (2024) Metacognition; Stanovich (2011) Epistemic Rationality; Kargupta et al. (2025) arXiv:2511.16660 [Self-Awareness & Uncertainty Monitoring]
primitives.formal_operator_definition: Partition premise set P into {P_entailed, P_independent, P_contradicted} under closed-world vs. open-world epistemic closure.
primitives.trigger_signature: Formal fallacies, syllogistic traps, underspecified premises, or causal questions where unstated assumptions tempt hallucinated extrapolation.
mandatory_slots: [Explicit_Premise_Inventory]: Enumerate strictly what is given in premise set P.
[Epistemic_Closure_Boundary]: Separate deductive entailment (P |= q) from plausible real-world presupposition.
[Decisive_Verdict]: Commit to validity/entailment verdict strictly within the epistemic boundary.
primitives.anti_bias_check: Prohibit Belief Bias (accepting logically invalid conclusions because they sound empirically familiar).

primitives.academic_citation: Aristotle Metaphysics; Newell & Simon (1959); Kargupta et al. (2025) arXiv:2511.16660 [Decomposition & Invariant Extraction]
primitives.formal_operator_definition: Decompose composite proposition X into minimal orthogonal axiom basis {a_1, ..., a_k} such that X = F(a_1, ..., a_k) and I(a_i; a_j) = 0.
primitives.trigger_signature: Physical/scientific reasoning, counter-intuitive mechanism analysis, or problems obscured by conventional heuristics and rule-of-thumb analogies.
mandatory_slots: [Heuristic_Assumption_Stripping]: Identify and discard conventional analogies or unverified surface assumptions.
[Irreducible_Axioms]: State the fundamental physical, mathematical, or logical conservation/axiomatic laws governing the system.
[Axiomatic_Reconstruction]: Reconstruct the conclusion deductively from the irreducible axioms in minimal steps.
primitives.anti_bias_check: Prohibit reasoning by herd analogy ('usually in similar cases...') when fundamental laws directly dictate the outcome.

primitives.name_zh_en: 最小描述长度剪枝 (MDL Parsimony & Razor Pruning)
primitives.academic_citation: Rissanen, J. (1978) Minimum Description Length; Grunwald (2007) The MDL Principle
primitives.formal_operator_definition: H^* = argmin_{H in M} [L(H) + L(D | H)], penalizing ad-hoc auxiliary hypotheses and intentionality/malice attributions.
primitives.trigger_signature: Competing explanations for an observed anomaly, diagnostic attribution, or social/systemic failure where complex conspiracy or ad-hoc hypotheses compete with structural/random causes.
mandatory_slots: [Candidate_Hypotheses_Complexity]: List competing hypotheses H_i and count required unverified assumptions L(H_i).
[Razor_Filter]: Prune high-complexity or malice-based hypotheses when a structural/stochastic null hypothesis explains the data D.
[Minimal_Sufficient_Explanation]: Select H^* minimizing total description length L(H) + L(D|H).
primitives.anti_bias_check: Prohibit Conjunction Fallacy and Teleological/Intentionality Bias (preferring elaborate narrative stories over parsimonious causal explanations).

primitives.name_zh_en: 证伪与反例检验 (Popperian Falsification & Counterexample Check)
primitives.academic_citation: Popper, K. (1959) The Logic of Scientific Discovery; Wason (1960) Confirmation Bias & Selection Task
primitives.formal_operator_definition: To test universal claim forall x: P(x) => Q(x), actively search for witness x_0 in {x | P(x) and not Q(x)} or confounder Z such that P(Y|X,Z) = P(Y|Z).
primitives.trigger_signature: Causal attribution claims, correlation-vs-causation traps, universal logical deductions, or elimination of multiple-choice distractors.
mandatory_slots: [Fact_vs_Inference_Separation]: Separate observed empirical facts from the proposed causal/universal claim.
[Counterexample_Confounder_Probe]: Construct the sharpest falsifying condition, boundary case, or confounding variable Z.
[Surviving_Proposition]: Retain only the claim/option that survives strict falsification.
primitives.anti_bias_check: Prohibit Confirmation Bias (seeking only supporting examples while ignoring disconfirming cases or confounders).

primitives.name_zh_en: 条件化张力融合与对称不变量 (Dialectical Boundary & Symmetry Invariant)
primitives.academic_citation: Noether (1918) Invariant Variation Problems; Nisbett et al. (2001) Holistic vs. Analytic Cognition
primitives.formal_operator_definition: Identify symmetry group G leaving system state invariant (g(S)=S) or partition parameter space Theta = Theta_+ U Theta_- where opposing propositions hold conditionally.
primitives.trigger_signature: Mathematical/logical symmetry problems, dual-aspect trade-offs, or paradoxes where two seemingly contradictory principles hold in different regimes.
mandatory_slots: [Symmetry_Dual_Identification]: Identify the underlying symmetry transformation or dual opposing forces (Thesis vs. Antithesis).
[Invariant_or_Regime_Boundary]: Extract the conserved invariant quantity or exact threshold separating regimes Theta_+ and Theta_-.
[Synthesized_Resolution]: Resolve the problem directly via the invariant or regime condition without brute-force expansion.
primitives.anti_bias_check: Prohibit binary absolutism (all-or-nothing judgment) and asymmetric brute-force expansion of symmetric structures.

primitives.name_zh_en: 存量流量与因果反馈环 (Causal DAG & Stock-Flow Feedback Loop)
primitives.academic_citation: Pearl, J. (2009) Structural Causal Models (SCM); Forrester (1961) System Dynamics; Meadows (2008) Thinking in Systems
primitives.formal_operator_definition: SCM M = <U, V, F, P(U)> with do-operator P(Y | do(X=x)) and stock equation S(t) = S(0) + int (Inflow - Outflow) dt with feedback polarity +/-.
primitives.trigger_signature: Observational vs. interventional queries (Ladder of Causation Rung 1/2/3), counterfactual evaluation, or dynamic systems with reinforcing/balancing feedback loops.
mandatory_slots: [Causal_Topology_DAG]: Explicitly map directed causal edges X -> M -> Y and identify confounders Z / colliders C.
[Do_Calculus_or_Feedback_Polarity]: Apply backdoor/frontdoor adjustment or classify feedback loop polarity (Reinforcing + vs. Balancing -) with delay delta_t.
[Net_Causal_Effect]: Compute net causal or counterfactual outcome after accounting for structural pathways.
primitives.anti_bias_check: Prohibit single-point linear attribution and confounding correlation P(Y|X) with interventional causation P(Y|do(X)).

primitives.name_zh_en: 关键路径卡点锁定 (Binding Constraint & Pareto Bottleneck Localization)
primitives.academic_citation: Goldratt (1984) Theory of Constraints; Ford & Fulkerson (1956) Max-Flow Min-Cut Theorem
primitives.formal_operator_definition: Throughput Phi(S) = min_{i in CriticalPath} Capacity(v_i); sensitivity dPhi / dCap(v_j) = 0 for all non-binding nodes j != i^*.
primitives.trigger_signature: Resource allocation, sequential pipeline capacity, multi-condition logical bottlenecks, or identifying the single decisive variable governing system output.
mandatory_slots: [Constraint_Chain_Quantification]: Map sequential or coupled constraints and their capacities/bounds.
[Binding_Bottleneck_Lock]: Isolate the unique minimum-cut / binding constraint v^* that strictly caps system output or truth value.
[Non_Bottleneck_Pruning]: Ignore non-binding variables and solve directly around v^*.
primitives.anti_bias_check: Prohibit uniform effort allocation (optimizing non-bottleneck components that have zero marginal effect on global throughput).

primitives.name_zh_en: 多阶效应与路径锁定树 (Multi-Order Consequence & Path-Dependence Tree)
primitives.academic_citation: Arthur, W. B. (1989) Increasing Returns and Path Dependence; Howard (1960) Sequential Decision Processes
primitives.formal_operator_definition: Evaluate trajectory V(a_0) = r_1(s_1, a_0) + gamma * E[r_2(s_2(a_0), a_1^*)] where early action a_0 restricts reachable state space S_{t>1}.
primitives.trigger_signature: Policy interventions, sequential state transitions, Cobra Effect traps, or irreversible early choices that constrain downstream options.
mandatory_slots: [First_Order_Immediate_Effect]: State the immediate local consequence of action a_0 at t=1.
[Second_Order_System_Adaptation]: Trace t=2 delayed feedback, adaptive counter-response, or state-space lock-in.
[Horizon_Integrated_Verdict]: Evaluate net outcome across the multi-order trajectory rather than t=1 myopic gain.
primitives.anti_bias_check: Prohibit Myopic First-Order Thinking (ignoring adaptive counter-responses and irreversible path lock-in).

primitives.name_zh_en: 网络生态位与宏观涌现拓扑 (Network Topology & Macro-Emergence)
primitives.academic_citation: Anderson, P. W. (1972) More Is Different; Newman (2010) Networks; Kargupta et al. (2025) arXiv:2511.16660 [Network & Hierarchical Organization]
primitives.formal_operator_definition: Macro-property P(G) emerges from relational adjacency matrix A_{ij} and local interaction rules phi(v_i, N(v_i)), irreducible to sum_i p(v_i).
primitives.trigger_signature: Multi-entity ordering, relational graph deduction, ecological/market equilibrium, or collective behavior arising from local pairwise constraints.
mandatory_slots: [Node_Edge_Adjacency_Graph]: Construct relational graph G=(V,E) from pairwise local constraints.
[Topological_Ordering_or_Centrality]: Compute global topological sort, cycle structure, or degree/bridge invariants.
[Macro_Emergent_Conclusion]: Read off the global rank/state directly from the assembled topology.
primitives.anti_bias_check: Prohibit Reductionist Fallacy (inferring macro-system behavior by summing isolated individual properties without interaction topology).

primitives.name_zh_en: 贝叶斯先验—似然动态校准 (Bayesian Prior-Likelihood Posterior Calibration)
mapped_folk_models: 概率思维与期望值思维 (#16)
primitives.academic_citation: Bayes (1763); Kahneman & Tversky (1973) Base-Rate Neglect; Griffiths & Tenenbaum (2006) Optimal Predictions in Everyday Cognition
primitives.formal_operator_definition: P(H | E) = [P(E | H) * P(H)] / [P(E | H)*P(H) + P(E | not H)*P(not H)]; Posterior Odds = Prior Odds * Likelihood Ratio LR.
primitives.trigger_signature: Diagnostic testing, conditional probability puzzles, imperfect evidence evaluation, or scenarios prone to base-rate neglect.
mandatory_slots: [Base_Rate_Prior]: Anchor the explicit prior probability P(H) before inspecting specific evidence E.
[Likelihood_Ratio_Calibration]: Quantify sensitivity P(E|H) and false-positive rate P(E|~H) to form Likelihood Ratio.
[Posterior_Belief_Update]: Compute exact or directional posterior P(H|E) via Bayes' rule.
primitives.anti_bias_check: Prohibit Base-Rate Neglect (equating P(H|E) with P(E|H) while ignoring low prior prevalence P(H)).

primitives.name_zh_en: 纳什均衡与激励相容前瞻 (Strategic Equilibrium & Incentive Lookahead)
primitives.academic_citation: von Neumann & Morgenstern (1944); Nash (1950); Maynard Smith (1982) Evolution and the Theory of Games
primitives.formal_operator_definition: Strategy profile s^* = (s_i^*, s_{-i}^*) is equilibrium iff forall i, s_i: u_i(s_i^*, s_{-i}^*) >= u_i(s_i, s_{-i}^*); solve sequential games via backward induction.
primitives.trigger_signature: Multi-agent strategic interaction, Prisoner's Dilemma / tragedy of the commons, signaling, or incentive design problems.
mandatory_slots: [Agents_Payoff_Structure]: Identify interacting agents, action spaces, and incentive payoff functions u_i.
[Best_Response_Dominance]: Eliminate strictly dominated strategies and compute opponent best-response reactions.
[Equilibrium_Outcome]: Identify the Nash / Subgame-Perfect / Evolutionary Stable equilibrium outcome.
primitives.anti_bias_check: Prohibit Single-Agent Egocentric Optimization (assuming other rational agents remain passive when incentives shift).

primitives.name_zh_en: 尾部风险与非对称凸性核算 (Tail-Risk Ergodicity & Antifragile Convexity)
primitives.academic_citation: Taleb (2012) Antifragile & Convexity Bias (Jensen's Inequality); Peters (2019) Ergodicity Economics; Rockafellar & Uryasev (2000) CVaR
primitives.formal_operator_definition: By Jensen's inequality, for convex payoff f(x), E[f(X)] >= f(E[X]); impose ruin barrier P(Wealth_t <= 0) = 0 and safety margin buffer delta_safe.
primitives.trigger_signature: Decision under high uncertainty, asymmetric payoff structures, absorbing ruin barriers (non-ergodic risk), or safety-critical system design.
mandatory_slots: [Tail_Ruin_Exposure]: Audit worst-case left-tail loss CVaR_alpha and check for absorbing ruin states.
[Convexity_Asymmetry]: Evaluate payoff curvature f''(x) (capped downside vs. convex upside) and required safety buffer.
[Robust_Antifragile_Choice]: Select strategy guaranteeing survival (zero ruin) and positive convexity under volatility.
primitives.anti_bias_check: Prohibit Ensemble-Average Illusion (ignoring absorbing ruin barriers in sequential repeated risks).

primitives.name_zh_en: 边际效益与机会成本核算 (Marginal Utility & Opportunity Cost Calculus)
primitives.academic_citation: Menger (1871) Marginalism; Coase (1937); Samuelson (1947) Foundations of Economic Analysis
primitives.formal_operator_definition: Net Economic Value(a_i) = U(a_i) - max_{j != i} U(a_j), with sunk costs C_sunk cancelled out: d[V(a_i) - C_sunk]/da_i = dU/da_i.
primitives.trigger_signature: Resource trade-offs, sunk-cost fallacy traps, incremental optimization, or long-horizon compounding vs. linear return comparisons.
mandatory_slots: [Sunk_Cost_Expurgation]: Explicitly zero out historical unrecoverable sunk costs C_sunk from the decision equation.
[Next_Best_Alternative_Benchmark]: Quantify the opportunity cost max_{j != i} U(a_j) of the foregone best alternative.
[Marginal_Compounding_Verdict]: Compare marginal incremental benefit dU/dx against marginal opportunity cost.
primitives.anti_bias_check: Prohibit Sunk Cost Fallacy (continuing a suboptimal option to 'justify' past unrecoverable expenditures).
